globalRollbackExpectations: Every future batch must run first as a local rollback dry run against the fixed Lia-vaud local container.
Each transaction must assert the 66-provider pre-batch baseline or the exact predecessor batch fingerprint, plus unchanged EMS and non-target domicile fingerprints.
Updates require serialized before-images; rollback restores every changed column, not only name/status.
New-row rollback uses the manifest's explicit stable IDs/slugs and deletes only those rows in reverse foreign-key order.
A count mismatch, unexpected pre-existing slug, missing source owner, or newly resolved hold aborts the whole sub-batch.
Publication and verification remain false after every identity batch.
No rollback or implementation command may target production Supabase.
